page.notes: Long s read as f in the printed text and transcribed as s (e.g. "fic", "fuos", "fancte", "miffæ"). "nobifcuui" is doubtful: probably "nobis cui" or a misprint, kept as close to the print as possible. "Innuidi" is printed with a consonant u; written as "Innvidi" and left as printed otherwise. A small stray mark (a dot) stands beside "Antonium" at the bottom of the page; it is not text and is not transcribed.
